name: video-creator
description: One command per visual style: /video-creator:voxel, /video-creator:3d-realistic, /video-creator:anime and 11 more, plus mix two styles, restyle a finished story and save your own. A screenwriter plans the shots in the style, code locks the style into every prompt, a free animatic shows the timing before you spend credits, a frame checker rejects bad frames, and ffmpeg cuts the styled video with moves, transitions, texture, a music bed and captions for Shorts, TikTok, Reels, YouTube or feed.
